I encourage folks who have had a similar experience to let the Better Business Bureau, the FTC, and econsumer dot gov know. This app needs to go.

body:
Their marketing is unprecedented. My ADHD brain was sucked in fast and thought wow this is the solution to all of my problems!

Write down your own routine and set an alarm. You'll achieve a much better outcome on your own rather than wasting $25 a month.
